locations.heading: Planning time with a change of scene
locations.description: Bring colleagues together for strategy discussions, then leave room for a coastal outing, a shared meal or time around the waterfront.

locations.heading: A slower setting for reconnecting
locations.description: Explore a lakeside retreat or a houseboat enquiry built around shared meals, team conversations and time away from the usual workday.

locations.heading: A memorable reward for the team
locations.description: Build a staff recognition trip around the Falls, with sightseeing, a celebration meal and an optional river experience to discuss.
locations.action: Plan a Victoria Falls incentive trip

locations.heading: A shared safari experience
locations.description: Consider a safari-led staff reward or small-group retreat, balancing wildlife outings with quiet time and conversations at your chosen base.

locations.heading: Island time for a team reset
locations.description: Explore a coastal retreat with time for team connection, relaxed meals and an optional Stone Town visit. Discuss any formal meeting needs in the brief.

locations.heading: An island reward with room to unwind
locations.description: Shape a reward trip around time together, a celebration dinner and an unhurried island stay. Room arrangements and group facilities can be discussed.

locations.heading: Business travel with time around the event
locations.description: Discuss travel for a conference, exhibition or business meeting, with accommodation, transfers and optional city or desert experiences around the working schedule.

locations.heading: A different backdrop for fresh thinking
locations.description: Explore a team retreat that mixes focused conversations with coastal time, local food or cultural outings. Allow for travel time when planning the programme.

events.title: Team offsites and strategy sessions
events.text: Bring a team together to plan the year, work through a shared challenge or reconnect across departments. Discuss meeting space, travel and downtime.

events.title: Conferences and exhibitions
events.text: Coordinate the travel around an event your staff will attend: departure groups, accommodation, airport transfers and the conference schedule.

events.title: Corporate retreats
events.text: Balance productive time with shared experiences and rest. Start with the reason for the retreat, then choose the destination and pace.

events.title: Incentive and staff recognition trips
events.text: Recognise a team milestone or reward staff with a shared travel experience. Set the group size, budget and experience priorities in the brief.

events.title: Training days and workshops
events.text: Plan travel and a suitable setting for staff learning or a working session. Share room layout, equipment, catering and accessibility requirements.

events.title: Year-end and staff celebrations
events.text: Explore a team dinner, a year-end getaway or a company milestone. Discuss dates, transport, accommodation and the kind of occasion you have in mind.
